geometry.derivationNote: The exact 30 January 1801 incorporation is replayed with the independently controlled 1803–1804 archive state. Distributed Caucasus controls show Kartli-Kakheti inside while Kutaisi, Batumi, Sukhumi, Gagra, Ganja, Sheki, Baku and Yerevan remain outside, so the fragment does not contain later Caucasus acquisitions. For monthly replay it replaces the pre-incorporation full state from the incorporation month.

territoryChanges.notes: Geometry-verified full-state replacement for the January 1801 incorporation; the fragment is bounded to 1802-12 for this backward use and does not include later Caucasus acquisitions.

geometry.derivationNote: Alexander I's September manifesto source-verifies the institution of direct internal administration over territory already incorporated earlier in 1801. This administrative transition must not add or redraw the external Russian territory a second time.

territoryChanges.notes: Administrative-state transition only; no second external-border acquisition is implied.
